ctx.x: When you were a kid, did you play on any toy drums or beat on anything?

No, no, no. I didn't beat on it. All I beat it on was the bottom of my mother's old wash tub or upside the fence, yeah. Yeah. So around 1918 I went to work at the Whitney National Bank as a night port. At that time they had Bud Russel, I know you know him. I've heard him. Ed Darcy was working there. Well Ed Darcy's still with him, yeah, but Bud Russel died. Well I was playing piano with a boyfriend of mine named Shedrick Brewster, but we called him nicknamed Baby Brewster, and we used to play house parties on…
What style? Was it something like Baby Dodds or anything particular about his style you could tell us?
